Offering approximately 1,488 square feet of living space on a generous 7,202 square foot lot, this home provides a comfortable floor plan with plenty of opportunity to make it your own. Enjoy the convenience of being near local schools, parks, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, while also being just down the street from Disneyland and the many attractions of the Anaheim Resort area.
